correctness.rationale: Proof checks the unique even-signed five-cycle Weyl class, all sixteen exceptional curves, forty ordinary nodes and their exact Frobenius orbits. The invariant 15-edge spanning tree yields twenty-five fundamental cycles in five regular integral C5 modules, proving the torus isomorphism without rationalizing. Normalization and finite-field blowdown establish the zeta and motivic formulas. Standalone code verifies the graph, chain signs, Weyl sign-lift conjugacy and extension counts. Char-2 and all-q existence follow from the smooth conic degree-five point construction.

value.rationale: The sixteen-exceptional-curve boundary of a quartic del Pezzo surface is a canonical stable genus-25 curve. Its exact arithmetic Picard torus and finite abelian group are natural invariants distinct from ambient surface point counts and complex complement homology. The irreducible quintic Frobenius regime is structurally singled out by the discriminant and occurs over every finite field. Determining five regular modules integrally, rather than only their rational characters, settles the nontrivial extension structure of the torus for this natural complete splitting class; motivic/zeta consequences describe the associated arithmetic open surface.
